closedText: Every week you compete in a group of up to 10 participants: the more you review, the higher you climb. The best move up a league, and those at the bottom move down one. A new race starts every Monday.
closedPrivacy: You need an account to take part. Other participants will see your name, character and points, never your email. You can leave at any time.
join: Try the race for the cup
signInAgain: Sign in to return to the league
unavailable: The league is not available here yet.
failed: Could not load the league. Check your connection.
endsIn: {count, plural, one {# day left this week} other {# days left this week}}
aloneTitle: You have the best result so far!
aloneText: With fewer than four participants in the group, nobody changes league. New rivals join when a new week starts.
zones: {up, plural, =0 {} one {First place moves up.} other {The top # places move up.}} {down, plural, =0 {} one {Last place moves down.} other {The last # places move down.}}
waitingText: Every race starts on a Monday. Then you join a group and your reviews start earning points.
rewardsText: They open as soon as you reach this league and stay while you are in it or higher.
resultUp: Last week you took place {rank} and moved up to the {tier} league!
resultDown: Last week you took place {rank} and moved down to the {tier} league. A new week, a new chance!
resultSame: Last week you took place {rank} and stayed in the {tier} league.
leaveText: Other participants will no longer see you, and your points and league will be gone. Your studying is not affected; you can come back at any time, from the first league.
demoBanner: Test participants: only you see this, and nothing goes to the server.
